_meta._archived_note: Synthesised RARES are drop-disabled everywhere, softcore included - not just Ruthless. They are dead content in every current league but still exist as LEGACY items in Standard, on characters and in stashes (filter author, 2026-07-30). Archived: moved under _archived/ and removed from category_structure.json + .yaml so the editor stops offering it, and excluded_modes stops it generating for ruthless. The rule was ALSO rescoped in the same move: it used to be a bare `SynthesisedItem True` with no Class, no Rarity and no ItemLevel, so it matched EVERY synthesised item in the game, and because Equipment emits before Uniques it stole the two synthesised-unique rules in Uniques/General.json (Rational Doctrine on Cobalt Jewel -> T0 Chase, and the six synth unique rings -> T1). `Rarity <= Rare` keeps it off uniques. Synthesised UNIQUES still drop and are covered by Uniques/General.json. Data kept intact for the Standard fork (ADR-0005). Unlike Currency/_archived/Breach.json, which is globally dead content with nothing left to own.
